title: Unbiased Stereology of SatB2+ Neurons in M2 Mouse Cortex
author: Jhodi Webster

steps.title: Prepare Slide Map
steps.instruction: Create a map of the slide using the stereology worksheet to indicate which sections will be counted, ensuring differentiation between ipsilateral and contralateral hemispheres if necessary.

steps.title: Position Slide on Microscope
steps.instruction: Set the slide properly on the microscope and establish a reference point anywhere on the slide.

steps.title: Configure Optical Fractionator Workflow
steps.instruction: Initialize the Optical Fractionator workflow in the software with the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Navigate to Probes > Optical Fractionator Workflow > Start a new subject
Label the subject/study
Set 'Existing sample in configuration' to 'no'
Set 'Number of sections to count' to 6
Enter cut thickness as 40μm
Set 'Section Evaluation Interval' to 6
Start with number one and set z-value of first section to 0

steps.title: Select Low Magnification Lens
steps.instruction: Select the 4X Low Mag Lens and proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Trace Contours of Interest
steps.instruction: Trace the contours of interest for each section on the slide.

substeps.instruction: Use separate contours to indicate left and right hemispheres if differentiating
Rename contour styles to reflect the specific hemisphere

steps.title: Select High Magnification Lens
steps.instruction: Select the 40X High Mag Lens (utilize light focuser/lens condenser if using an upright scope) and proceed to the next step.

steps.title: Enter Mounted Thickness
steps.instruction: Select 'manually enter the average mounted thickness' and enter 33 μm.

steps.title: Define Counting Frame and Grid
steps.instruction: Configure the counting frame and grid layout to ensure approximately 5-10 cells are visible per frame.

substeps.instruction: Set counting frame to 40 µm x 40 µm and force it to be square
Manually enter SRS Grid Layout as 200 x 200

steps.title: Initiate Object Counting
steps.instruction: Begin the counting process for the selected regions.

substeps.instruction: Select the first section
Select the desired region
Select a distinct marker for each side if using different contours for 'left' and 'right'
Start counting

steps.title: Establish Z-Plane Focus
steps.instruction: Focus on the top of the tissue by focusing at any z-plane and adjusting the fine focus 'up' until slightly out of focus, then click OK.

steps.title: Count Cells in Z-Plane
steps.instruction: Count cells with visible nuclei within the square by scrolling through the z-plane.

substeps.instruction: Select markers according to the desired cell types
Scroll up and down throughout the z-plane and click on cells to add markers
Count cells touching the green line of the counting frame
Do NOT count cells touching the red line of the counting frame

steps.title: Export Results
steps.instruction: Complete the counting process and export the data.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Completed Counting' after visiting all sites and selecting all contours
Navigate to View Results > Export to Excel
Verify that coefficients of error are below the threshold of 0.12
